name: com.haruchanz64.playables-animator-controller
description: Code-driven 2D and 3D animation controller for Unity 6 built on the Playables API without AnimatorController state graphs. Includes cross-fade blending, masked layers, normalized-time events, an optional code state machine, and a UI Toolkit debugger.

samples.description: Minimal 2D side-scroller and 3D layered animation examples using PlayablesAnimatorController without an AnimatorController.
